As you can see, the WhoaVerse monster is significantly more complex, and requires more space to be as easily identifiable. While not very important beyond aesthetics, having an easy-to-recognize icon might just help users to spread WhoaVerse. Sure, posters in public places can kind of spread the word, but Snoo is known internet-wide because you can see it at the size of text and still know where it's from.
